products.title: halo beriti - special prep
products.body_html:
From : Gedeb, Yirgacheffe, Ethiopia (2100-2300 MASL)

Varietal : Landrace 

Process : Washed

Notes : Plumcot, Muscat Grape, Wildflower Honey 

125g whole coffee beans

 

Processing

Coffee cherries are picked and depulped the same day, fermented for 8-12 hours in open tanks, washed to remove mucilage, then spread on raised beds to dry for 5-15 days. 

Taste

This is the next coffee in delicates participation in Ethiopia season. This coffee is a really unique representation of a washed Ethiopian. This coffee has lots of definition in its fruit qualities, leaning into a variety of stonefruit and […]

Lot Info

products.title: bare - special prep
products.body_html:
From : Bona Zuria, Sidama, Ethiopia (2100-2200 MASL)

Varietal : Mixed JARC (74158, 74165, 74112, 74110, 7440)

Process : White Honey

Notes : Golden Raspberry, Lemon Sugar, Lilac 

125g whole coffee beans

 

Taste

This is another delicious and fun Ethiopian coffee. It is our first non-washed coffee and from the famous Sidama zone. This coffee is on the cleaner side of honey-processing and presents very much like a washed coffee. The acidity and […]

 

Processing 

Before the carefully-selected ripe cherries head to the pulper, they are further hand sorted for color consistency, floated for  density, then hand sorted again. White honey processing is the closest to washed-process; once pulped, the […]

 

The Tulu Family and Bare Site

products.title: danche
products.body_html:
From: Chelbesa, Gedeb, Gedeo, Ethiopia

Varietal: JARC 74110, 74112

Process: Washed

Notes: Yuzu, White Peach, Jasmine

125g whole coffee beans 


Processing

Cherries are sorted for defects, pulped and with 10% of their mucilage remaining are fermented for 24 hours. Next is handwashed  and dried on shaded beds for 9-12 days. During this process the coffee is turned every few hours to ensure […]

 

Taste 

This coffee is delicates entrance to Ethiopia season and we are starting with all gas, no breaks. This coffee shows up in cup with soft citrus notes which lead into its clean and strong jasmine florals. The florals are nicely complemented […]

 

Region 

This lot contains 100% cherry from the Danche community which sits between 2000-2300 MASL, a locality in the chelbesa kebele (which is having a stellar year). It was processed by Habtamu Fikadu of of Kuri Mountain Coffee. Kuri Mountain […]

products.title: getuya AA
products.body_html:
From: Muranga, Kenya

Varietal: SL28, SL34, Ruiru 11, Batian 

Process: Washed

Notes: Blood Orange, Champagne Mango, Cranberry

125g whole coffee beans 

 

Processing

Cherries are picked and depulped the same day. Fermented in open-air concrete tanks for 24-48 hours. Washed again and soaked underwater for another 12-72 hours. Finally coffees are dried on raised beds. 


Taste

I have a strong love for washed Kenyan coffees so we must continue on with more juicy  + punchy coffees. This is another bright Kenyan with a citric forward profile containing lots of red and orange fruits. This coffee has plenty of […]


Region

This Getuya AA separation brings us to another region of Kenya we haven’t entered yet, Muranga. Muranga county sits on the western slope of the Aberdare Mountains around 1850 MASL. The soil is rich and red with a climate that is cooler […]


Washing Station 

The Getuya Factory is operated by the New Murarandia Farmers Cooperative Society (FCS). The FCS has a total of 3,500 smallholder producer members. Each farmer owns anywhere from ⅕-⅓ of a a hectare of land and delivers cherry to the factory.

products.title: kathima AB
products.body_html:
From: Embu, Kenya

Varietal: SL28, SL34, Ruiru 11

Process: Washed

Notes: Pink Lemonade, Purple Plum, Jamaica

125g whole coffee beans

 

Cherries are carefully sorted before pulping, then fermented to remove mucilage under controlled conditions. After fermentation, the parchment is thoroughly washed and soaked in clean water. Drying is done on raised beds. 

We chose to bring on this beautiful coffee from Kenya to offer a coffee from a different county on the slopes of Mt. Kenya. This coffee offers a wildly different end cup than our Kii duo boasting a delicious pink/purple flavor profile. […]


About the Washing Station
